description: Record the result of a requested meter change against the expected project version and graph digest, including the before and after source fingerprints.

baseSourceFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the meter source before the change.

expectedProjectVersion.description: Current hosted project version from get_project_status; guards against overwriting a newer graph publication.

expectedVersion.description: Current version of the target record from its latest read or mutation result. A stale value causes a version conflict; re-read before retrying.

graphDigest.description: Digest identifying the graph snapshot for this operation.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

projectId.description: Owned project ID returned by list_linked_projects or map_project; do not use a local path or repository URL.

requestId.description: Existing request record ID returned by the corresponding request creation or pending-request listing.

resultSummary.description: Brief account of the implemented meter change.

resultingMeterKey.description: Key of the implementation meter after the requested change.

resultingSourceFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the meter source after the change.

sessionId.description: Active session record.id from start_agent_session for this project. Pass it on later project calls after starting the session.

name: apply_implementation_meter_change
